hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab350b65_featurestore "
WITH m AS (
  SELECT avg(pm25) my, avg(pm25_lag1) m1, avg(wind_speed) m2, avg(humidity) m3 FROM airq6e979b_1
),
s AS (
  SELECT
    sum((pm25_lag1-m1)*(pm25_lag1-m1)) S11,
    sum((wind_speed-m2)*(wind_speed-m2)) S22,
    sum((humidity-m3)*(humidity-m3)) S33,
    sum((pm25_lag1-m1)*(wind_speed-m2)) S12,
    sum((pm25_lag1-m1)*(humidity-m3)) S13,
    sum((wind_speed-m2)*(humidity-m3)) S23,
    sum((pm25_lag1-m1)*(pm25-my)) S1y,
    sum((wind_speed-m2)*(pm25-my)) S2y,
    sum((humidity-m3)*(pm25-my)) S3y,
    arbitrary(my) my, arbitrary(m1) m1, arbitrary(m2) m2, arbitrary(m3) m3
  FROM airq6e979b_1 CROSS JOIN m
),
c AS (
  SELECT *,
    S11*(S22*S33-S23*S23) - S12*(S12*S33-S23*S13) + S13*(S12*S23-S22*S13) AS det,
    S1y*(S22*S33-S23*S23) - S12*(S2y*S33-S23*S3y) + S13*(S2y*S23-S22*S3y) AS d1,
    S11*(S2y*S33-S3y*S23) - S1y*(S12*S33-S23*S13) + S13*(S12*S3y-S2y*S13) AS d2,
    S11*(S22*S3y-S2y*S23) - S12*(S12*S3y-S2y*S13) + S1y*(S12*S23-S22*S13) AS d3
  FROM s
),
b AS (
  SELECT d1/det b1, d2/det b2, d3/det b3, my - (d1/det)*m1 - (d2/det)*m2 - (d3/det)*m3 a FROM c
)
SELECT b.a, b.b1, b.b2, b.b3,
  sqrt(avg(power(t.pm25 - (b.a + b.b1*t.pm25_lag1 + b.b2*t.wind_speed + b.b3*t.humidity),2))) rmse3
FROM airq6e979b_1 t CROSS JOIN b GROUP BY b.a,b.b1,b.b2,b.b3" 2>&1 | tail -4
tool_input.description: 3-predictor OLS via Cramer's rule and residual RMSE

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab350b65_featurestore "
WITH tr AS (SELECT * FROM airq6e979b_1 WHERE date < '2025-01-01'),
m AS (SELECT avg(pm25) my, avg(pm25_lag1) m1, avg(wind_speed) m2, avg(humidity) m3, avg(pressure) m4 FROM tr),

  sum((wind_speed-m2)*(wind_speed-m2)) S22, sum((wind_speed-m2)*(humidity-m3)) S23, sum((wind_speed-m2)*(pressure-m4)) S24,
  sum((humidity-m3)*(humidity-m3)) S33, sum((humidity-m3)*(pressure-m4)) S34,
  sum((pressure-m4)*(pressure-m4)) S44,
  sum((pm25_lag1-m1)*(pm25-my)) Y1, sum((wind_speed-m2)*(pm25-my)) Y2, sum((humidity-m3)*(pm25-my)) Y3, sum((pressure-m4)*(pm25-my)) Y4,
  arbitrary(my) my, arbitrary(m1) m1, arbitrary(m2) m2, arbitrary(m3) m3, arbitrary(m4) m4
  FROM tr CROSS JOIN m),
e1 AS (SELECT *,
  S12/S11 f2, S13/S11 f3, S14/S11 f4,
  S22-(S12/S11)*S12 a22, S23-(S12/S11)*S13 a23, S24-(S12/S11)*S14 a24, Y2-(S12/S11)*Y1 yy2,
  S23-(S13/S11)*S12 a32, S33-(S13/S11)*S13 a33, S34-(S13/S11)*S14 a34, Y3-(S13/S11)*Y1 yy3,
  S24-(S14/S11)*S12 a42, S34-(S14/S11)*S13 a43, S44-(S14/S11)*S14 a44, Y4-(S14/S11)*Y1 yy4
  FROM s),
e2 AS (SELECT *,

sol AS (SELECT *,

sol2 AS (SELECT *, (Y1 - S12*b2 - S13*b3 - S14*b4)/S11 b1 FROM sol),
fin AS (SELECT b1,b2,b3,b4, my - b1*m1 - b2*m2 - b3*m3 - b4*m4 a FROM sol2)
SELECT f.b1,f.b2,f.b3,f.b4,f.a,
  sqrt(avg(power(t.pm25-(f.a+f.b1*t.pm25_lag1+f.b2*t.wind_speed+f.b3*t.humidity+f.b4*t.pressure),2))) holdout_rmse_2025
FROM airq6e979b_1 t CROSS JOIN fin f WHERE t.date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY f.b1,f.b2,f.b3,f.b4,f.a" 2>&1 | tail -3
